data.exact_reserve_text: The release during 2015 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2014 was GBP 14,497,316 with a further release of risk margin and unallocated loss adjustment expense provision ("ULAE") of GBP 11,655,032 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 26,152,348.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 577.705m. The gross claims development table (gross of reinsurance) shows no material movement on underwriting years 2011-2013 (aggregate gross prior-year development approx. GBP 0.0m), so on a gross basis the prior-year position is essentially flat. The Managing Agent does report net releases of GBP 26.152m (after reinsurance) driven by settled claims and the release of risk margin and ULAE.
raw_causal_phrases: The release during 2015 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2014 was GBP 14,497,316 with a further release of risk margin and unallocated loss adjustment expense provision ("ULAE") of GBP 11,655,032 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 26,152,348.
There has been concerted effort made during the past year to reduce the backlogs, which has led to a catch up in the proportion of claims that have been settled.
As a result, greater weight has been given to the paid claims development data when calculating provisions because this is not as materially distorted;

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was derived from the gross claims development table (triangle). The Managing Agent narrative reports a net release of GBP 26.152m (after reinsurance) for prior years; that net figure is quoted verbatim in exact_reserve_text but is NOT used as the gross PYD (per instructions). The gross triangle shows no material movement for underwriting years 2011-2013 (aggregate ~GBP 0.0m). All triangle amounts are presented in the accounts in GBP 000; gross premium mix taken from the segmental analysis (GBP 000).
